description: As of 2026, visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 39 countries and territories, ranked 93rd by Henley. Other indices: 89th on the Global Passport Power Rank, 96th on Passport Index with a world reach of 23%, and 180th of 199 on VisaGuide's measure.
energy_note: Thirty-nine doors, out of roughly two hundred.

aspect: Accepted as a document, not as a citizenship
description: The United States among others accepts the passport as a valid travel document, but that acceptance does not imply recognition of citizenship, since it is not issued by a state it recognises.
energy_note: Good enough to travel on, not good enough to be from.

aspect: And three states will not take it at all
description: As of 2020, Georgia, Syria and Madagascar did not recognise the Palestinian passport as a valid travel document; holders had to apply using another country's refugee travel document.
energy_note: A passport some countries simply do not accept.
notes: Sourced via Chinese-language Wikipedia's 巴勒斯坦护照 entry, which carries the fullest recognition list found.

aspect: It does not reach the people who most need a document
description: Palestinians in Syria, Lebanon, Iraq and Egypt who hold no Palestinian ID card do not get one. They receive whatever special document their country of residence chooses to issue.
energy_note: The passport of your nation, unavailable to you.

aspect: Every visa application is a long-form one
description: A weak document means interviews rather than online forms, bank statements, sponsors, itineraries, insurance, and a refusal rate that makes the whole exercise a gamble with a non-refundable fee.
energy_note: Paying to be considered, and usually refused.

description: The abstract is accepted in March for a June conference. The Portuguese appointment in Amman is in May, which requires a bridge crossing, which requires two days. The visa arrives eight days after the conference ends. She presents by video, at 2am, to an empty room.

aspect: The cumulative effect is a career with no international layer
description: Fieldwork, collaborations, fellowships, external examiners, conference networks. Each is individually blocked by an administrative delay; together they are the difference between a national and an international career.

aspect: EXAMPLE - three states that do not accept it at all
description: As of 2020, Georgia, Syria and Madagascar did not recognise the Palestinian passport as a valid travel document. Holders travelling there had to apply using another country's refugee travel document instead.
energy_note: A passport that is not a passport in three countries.
